selection_rationale: An all-fast (3g) doctrine built around torpedo saturation: corvettes deliver 8-torpedo salvos each while staying faster than any capital ship can kite, forcing engagement on our terms; frigates (also 3g) screen the corvettes, add extra PD lasers to blunt counter-fire, and chip enemy armor with coilguns, all without slowing the formation to feed a slower enemy's guns.
formation_rationale: Corvettes form a wide forward arc (staggered in x/y/z) to complicate enemy spinal-weapon targeting while still keeping overlapping PD bubbles against incoming torpedoes. The frigates are held well back as a refused reserve, clustered tightly together for mutual point-defense coverage and kept out of the initial gun exchange, with slight vertical offset to avoid a single raking shot catching all three.
